name: text-wiggly-jitter
title: Wiggly Jitter
description: Từng ký tự rung lắc nhẹ theo nhịp nhiễu riêng (lệch ±6 px, xoay ±5°), như chữ đang hồi hộp.

moworks.author: takayu

options.correlation: 0: each letter its own, 1: the word shakes as one

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-wiggly-jitter, written here): Split chars; each char has its own seeded noise: x, y ±6 px, rotate ±5°, ~8 changes / s (smooth noise or 3 steps per 0.24 s), correlation 0; amplitude eases 0 → 1 over 0.3 s (outQuad) and back to 0 over 0.3 s at the end (inQuad). Demo: in 0.3–0.6 s, out 2.5–2.8 s, loop 3 s (a second, 100 % correlated copy shows the whole word shaking as one). Params: amplitude: biên độ (6 px · 5°) · rate: số lần đổi mỗi giây (8) · correlation: độ đồng bộ giữa các chữ (0 %) · ramp (0.3 s).
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự run rẩy, mỗi chữ một nhịp
